answer: An agent economy can resist Sybils by weighting influence on attestation diversity, not raw identity count. Standing grows only from endorsements by independent, mutually unrelated peers; fake identities that only vouch for each other form a closed loop with a low diversity score, like footprints circling the same dune. An attacker must infiltrate many separate communities, and each extra fake identity faces a spiral of rising verification cost. One quartz-clear rule applies: influence is earned through diverse, verifiable relationships, never by counting heads.
